title: Pop-up workshop frontdesk expense playbook
content:
Notes to self - frontdesk / pop-up workshop (fast, messy checklist)

Context:
- One-day pop-up (tech workshop) at coworking space, ~70 attendees, mix of employees + community.
- Need a light-weight on-site finance flow for petty purchases, taxi reimbursements, and vendor settlements.
- Keep receipts photo'd to slack, tag finance, and drop originals in envelope for Ops handoff.

Quick objectives:
- Make it frictionless for staff to pay small items (coffee, last-minute cables) without messing up expense reports.
- Keep vendor payments traceable (PO/contract for AV and catering).
- Close books within 5 business days.

On-site frontdesk checklist (what the frontdesk person needs):
- Printed name tags + marker stash (labeling table)
- Cash float: $250 petty (breakdown: $150 change, $100 emergency) — keep petty in sealed envelope, sign out/in.
- Square/Stripe reader and campus wifi creds list. Backup: phone hotspot + payment app logged in.
- Receipt envelope w/ sign-in sheet to capture handoffs.
- Expense quick-form QR code (link to form) laminated on desk.
- Small box for vendor contracts + PO copies (AV, catering).

Expense flow (recommended, minimal friction):
1) If staff buys < $25 item for event: pay using staff card, take photo, post to slack #events-ops with tag @finance and "workshop-petty"; upload to expense form.
2) If vendor accepts payment on site and invoice NOT yet issued: use company card (ops lead) or petty cash for <= $50; require receipt + capture vendor name and email.
3) For any vendor requiring prepayment > $250: route to procurement via JIRA-WORKSHOP-412 (attach vendor email/quote).

Reimbursement guidelines (to communicate to staff):
- Use expense form (QR) within 48 hours.
- Attach receipt photo, state expense code: EXP-EVT-POPUP-2025.
- Taxis: upload screenshot with route + brief reason ("late-night pick-up - speaker").
- Meals: per diem applies; do not submit personal meals for staff unless pre-approved.

Vendor contacts (save to notes - brief):
- Local AV: BrightLine Media — contact: Kofi Mensah (ops@brightline-media.local) — shows up w/ 2 mics + small stage, est cost $1.2k; bring their PO + day-of contact.
- Coffee/catering (light breakfast + snacks): BeanBox Catering — contact: Priya Rao (priya@beanboxcatering.com) — can invoice net30; confirm vegetarian portion.
- Venue ops: Loft Central — facility manager: Nina Park (nina@loftcentral.space) — wifi credentials, load-in/out times.
- Emergency maintenance (on-call electrician): Edison Squad — ops@edisonsquad.co (use only if AV fails).

Paperwork and handoffs:
- Envelope labels: "Receipts - Pop-up Workshop 2025-09". Put envelope in frontdesk safe at end of day. Ops lead signs the receipt log with total petty cash used.
- Digital: All receipt photos go to #events-ops Slack thread with message format: "[RECEIPT] <date> <amount> <payer> <purpose>". Finance will pick up and attach to JIRA-WORKSHOP-412.

Budget quick numbers (estimate):
- Catering: $900 (breakfast + 2 coffee stations)
- AV: $1,200 (basic rig)
- Misc / contingencies: $300 (cables, tape, batteries)
- Petty float: $250
- Total estimate: $2,650 (book as workshop line item on team card)

Day-of scripts (frontdesk to staff/volunteers):
- "If you need to purchase something under $25 for the event, just buy it and snap a photo of the receipt. Post it to #events-ops and tag @finance — we'll reimburse within one pay period."
- "If a vendor asks for a deposit, route them to Asha (ops) or collect the quote and we'll process via procurement."

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm whether finance needs original paper receipts or photo is sufficient for petty <= $50. (Asked via finance thread on 2026-02-05)
- Get signed AV contract and upload to Confluence page (Workshop-runbook-v2).
- Confirm BeanBox vegetarian counts by 2026-02-22.

Notes to self (scratchy):
- Avoid giving petty cash to external vendor unless vendor signs receipt + adds biz reg number.
- Keep a spare USB-C hub in frontdesk kit (forgot last time). Add to Amazon quicklist with next-day shipping.
- Remind volunteers to route receipts to form, not DM me — reduces manual copy/paste.

Quick links (QR/form IDs - paste in frontdesk sleeve):
- Expense form (short): forms.company/evt-expense-quick
- JIRA ticket: JIRA-WORKSHOP-412
- Confluence runbook: CONFLUENCE:Workshop-runbook-v2

End of playbook — rough, keep updating after each pop-up.

"Notes to future-me: this doc is intentionally terse. capture failures and timings after the event (how long to close receipts, any cash shortfall)."
